question: Does the O12->O13 scanner event represent an intrinsic depth-dependent O-regime raise, rather than a deterministic exploratory-panel membership transition inside an unchanged fixed grammar?

authority.O10_plus: synthetic exact finite instances of the certified generic recursive lift; not historical graduations

gates.A1_reproduce_candidate: Reproduce the official default-beam O11/O12/O13 lane summaries and O12 raise-candidate pattern.
gates.A2_full_support: Verify every owner in every O11/O12/O13 audit candidate has positive support for all seven endpoint types.
gates.A3_recipe_invariance: For every common frozen construction recipe, the normalized branching/symmetry/lineage/topology-service signature must be compared exactly across O11/O12/O13.
gates.A4_matched_panels: Evaluate at least two independent frozen recipe-matched 24-state panels plus the complete generated candidate pool; do not choose panels using scanner outcomes.
gates.A5_selection_causality: Compare default-beam recipe membership across O11/O12/O13 and test whether aggregate lane movement can be accounted for by recipe membership changes.
gates.A6_raise_criterion: A raise survives only if a depth-dependent per-recipe or matched-panel change appears in at least three independent established lane families and persists at the next level.

matched_panel_rules.LEX24: Freeze the lexicographically first 24 recipe IDs present at O8 and reuse exactly those IDs at every later level.
matched_panel_rules.STRAT24: Freeze a deterministic round-robin panel over lane and owner-count strata at O8 and reuse exactly those recipe IDs at every later level.
matched_panel_rules.FULL_POOL: Use the complete deterministic generated candidate recipe pool at each level.

scope.note: The audit tests the scanner's claimed organizational raise only. It does not prove or disprove every possible observer-relative depth effect.

nonclaims: No physical geometry, dimension, time or propagation claim.
No global fixed-point or raised carrier claim from observer-relative scanner invariance alone.
